description: A sign-in, sign-up or password page: your brand, a heading, the form and a line under it. Split puts the form beside a panel in your brand's colour on large screens, with a quote or a few words at its foot, and gives the form the page on phones; centered sets it on a card in the middle. The form rises into place as the page paints, unless motion is reduced. No script, so it works inside Livewire components as it is.
